admission.justification: Checking immutable launch scope before resume prevents an old agent resuming into a different current enclosure.

applicability: Revival of leaf-bound worker, reviewer or curator, including grant-backed direct leaves.
exclusions: Taskless and sprint/master contexts retain their separate rules.
statement: Before reviving a leaf-bound role, compare the receipt canonical task/contract pair with the current product-resolved pair: a granted direct leaf uses its readable grant and master series contract, an enclosed leaf its canonical enclosure. Missing or changed identity refuses with both values before bridge revival; this comparison creates or starts nothing.
